fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Korea University is in Seoul. This page uses the **Global MBA** at Korea University Business School (KUBS). It is a one-year, 45-credit MBA.

- **Length:** 1 year in 6 modules of 8 weeks each. You need **45 credits** and a GPA of at least 3.0.
- **Application fee:** **KRW 100,000** (**₹6,945**). KRW 30,000 comes back if you fail the document screening.
- **English test:** nationals of India are on the university's exemption list.
- **Money for the visa:** **USD 30,000** (**₹27.87 lakh**) in the Fall 2026 round.
- **Latest dates posted:** the Fall 2026 round had three application windows from 21 January to 17 April 2026. Fall 2027 dates are not posted yet.

Rupee amounts use **₹0.0694 per Korean won**. We built it from the RBI rate and the Bank of Korea closing rate for 27 November 2026. Your bank's rate will differ.

## Who can apply

The Fall 2026 guide says you need a bachelor's degree, or expect one by August 2026. Applicants outside the Korean quota must be **foreign nationals whose parents are also foreign nationals**. A Korean citizen who finished all schooling abroad can also apply. Indian citizens fit the first group if both parents also hold Indian citizenship.

## English test

You send a test score from TOEIC, TOEFL, IELTS, TEPS or OPIc. The university lists exemptions. One is for **nationals of listed countries, and India is on the list**. Another is for a degree from a university in a listed country. Check the guide for the current list.

## Dates

The Fall 2026 round had three windows:

| Round | Online application | Documents by | Interview |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 21 January to 11 February 2026 | 11 February 2026 | 6 or 7 March 2026 |
| 2 | 27 February to 20 March 2026 | 20 March 2026 | 10 or 11 April 2026 |
| 3 | 31 March to 17 April 2026 | 17 April 2026 | Not listed |

The Fall 2027 dates are not posted on the pages we read. The page mixes 2023 and 2026 text, so check the date before you plan.

## Visa and money

For the Fall 2026 round the university asked successful non-Korean candidates for a bank statement. It had to show at least **USD 30,000** or the same amount in another currency (₹27.87 lakh). A scholarship holder shows the difference between USD 30,000 and the scholarship. Read our [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/south-korea/south-korea-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules on the statement.

## What we could not confirm

We did not find an official tuition figure for the Global MBA that we could tie to this programme. The university's FAQ page lists several MBA programmes together. Ask KUBS for the current fee at mba_admissions@korea.ac.kr.

## Sources

Official pages, checked on 28 November 2026: [KUBS Global MBA admissions](https://biz.korea.ac.kr/eng/mba/globalMBA/admission), [KUBS Global MBA curriculum](https://biz.korea.ac.kr/eng/mba/globalMBA/curriculum.html), [RBI exchange rates](https://www.rbi.org.in/) and the [Bank of Korea ECOS statistics](https://ecos.bok.or.kr).
